response.text: There are several anomalies. I'll examine the unusual journals (credit memo, rent, the invoice mismatches, the negative invoice, the 5900 usage) and the GL accruals.

arguments.sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_CD", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines, i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h LEFT JOIN "APINVH" i ON i."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."JRNL_NO">=2430 OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0) OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "ACCT_CD"='5900    ') OR h."JRNL_NO" IN (SELECT i2."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i2 WHERE i2."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT sum("CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i2."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000    ')) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 'unbalanced' k, h."JRNL_NO"::text a, sum("DR_AMT")::text b, sum("CR_AMT")::text c FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY h."JRNL_NO" HAVING sum("DR_AMT")<>sum("CR_AMT") UNION ALL SELECT 'ap_vendor_in_srcref_ne_inv_vendor', i."INV_ID"::text, i."VEND_CD", h."SRC_REF" FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") WHERE left(h."SRC_REF",5)<>trim(i."VEND_CD") LIMIT 20

SELECT 'pay_jrnl_match' k, count(*)::text a, '' b FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."SRC_REF"='PAY-'||p."PAY_ID" JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000    ' AND l."DR_AMT"=p."PAY_AMT" AND h."POST_DT"=p."PAY_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_ids', min("PAY_ID")::text, max("PAY_ID")::text FROM "APPAYM" UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_ids', min("INV_ID")::text, max("INV_ID")::text FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_lines_per_hdr', "SRC_CD"||count(*)::text, '' FROM (SELECT h."SRC_CD", h."JRNL_NO", count(*) FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLJRNL" l USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2) x GROUP BY "SRC_CD", "count" UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_period_mismatch', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" WHERE i."INV_DT" NOT BETWEEN p."STRT_DT" AND p."END_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'vendor_trailing', count(*)::text, max(length("VEND_CD"))::text FROM "APVEND" UNION ALL SELECT 'invvend_len', count(distinct length("VEND_CD"))::text, max(length("VEND_CD"))::text FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_posts_closed_period_late', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."SRC_CD"='GL' AND h."POST_DT">p."END_DT"
